# Radoslav Radev Requires Minimum 15 Pull-Ups, 20 Dips, and 30 Push-Ups Before Attempting Planche, Front Lever, Handstand, or Handstand Push-Ups

Radoslav Radev requires a foundation of minimum 15 pull-ups, 20 dips, and 30 push-ups with good form before attempting skills like planche, front lever, handstand, or handstand push-ups. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 00:44]

## Details

- Before skills like planche, front lever, handstand, or handstand push-ups, you need a base of minimum 15 pull-ups, 20 dips, and 30 push-ups with good form. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 00:44]
- If you have these numbers, it is enough preparation and you are ready; if you do not have them, it is a potential reason for injury. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:19]

## Evidence

- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 00:44 (Radoslav Radev): "the first thing you don't have enough foundation before you even think about skills like planche, front lever, handstand, or handstand push-ups, you need a base. Minimum 15 pull-ups, 20 dips, and 30 push-ups with good form."
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 00:55 (Radoslav Radev): "If you don't have this, your muscles are not ready and your joints will take the stress. And this is where the injury starts."
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:19 (Radoslav Radev): "So this number is really good preparation and if you have it, it's enough. If you don't have it, this is potential reason for injury."

## Why This Matters

He says that without this foundation, your muscles are not ready and your joints will take the stress, which is where injury starts. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 00:55]
